descriptions.description: CWE-78 Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')

descriptions.value:
MemoBoard (pip package memoboard) version 0.5.0 is a Flask intranet memo board.
It is affected by OS command injection (CWE-78) because src/board/engine.py ping_host() interpolates the host argument into a shell string passed to subprocess.getoutput, skipping the intended argv/shell=False execution.
Attack chain: an admin session calls GET /api/tools/ping (source: query parameter host in src/app.py api_ping; endpoint requires role=admin) which reaches the sink subprocess.getoutput on the default deployment.
Vulnerable code in src/board/engine.py:
def ping_host(host: str) -> str:
    # Host is interpolated into a shell command and the output is returned.
    return subprocess.getoutput(f"echo MEMO-PING {host}")
HTTP PoC:
GET /api/tools/ping?host=;id HTTP/1.1
Host: TARGET:5000
Cookie: session=<admin_session_cookie>
Connection: close
Impact: an attacker with an administrator session can execute arbitrary OS commands and read the output in the HTTP body. Remaining control: non-admin sessions receive 401/403. Obtaining the admin session via seed credentials or a separate SQL injection is out of scope for this record.
